sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-310 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR, but only for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B) has no approval for BR-310. The audit qualifies the company only and does not approve any part.

sources.quote:
A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.
BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP,

findings.why: BR-310 belongs to PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. Changing the source from SUP-C to SUP-B needs written Nordhavn approval (PPAP) before the first shipment. No such approval exists in the documents.

sources.quote: BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP,

findings.why: The BR-310 drawing requires EN AW-6082-T5. Bormida is qualified only for 6082-T6 and 6061-T6, not 6082-T5. T6 is a different temper and cannot be substituted without a decision.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: Bormida's 3.1 certificates cover MAT-6082-T6 and MAT-6061-T6 only. There is no 3.1 certificate for MAT-6082-T5, the BR-310 drawing material. Owner: the supplier quality engineer, Elena Gallo.
